system.description: The Lunar's magic brings a specific point or detail to the forefront of his target's mind and makes it seem important. The player rolls (Manipulation + Presence) at a difficulty of (the target's highest of Perception or relevant Ability). The relevant Ability depends on what the Lunar gives significance: Awareness for a visual detail or a scent, Socialize or Bureaucracy for particular wordings and Melee to notice something about a person's blade katas, for a few examples. If the roll succeeds, the target notices whatever detail--be it a bent blade of grass in the field, a particular wording at a dinner party or part of a blueprint--and knows that it is important. Three points of Willpower throw off this effect.
